column1: # Covers Taiwanese-origin / Taiwan-headquartered brands: PC and component makers and their product lines,
# semiconductors and electronics manufacturing, networking and storage, bicycles, scooters and tyres,
# airlines and shipping, banks and financial groups, telecom, food, bubble tea and drinks, spirits,
# retail and internet, games, media and newspapers, cosmetics, baseball clubs.
# Hangul: Korean market names and Korean media usage first (에이수스, 에이서, 폭스콘, 훙하이, 공차, 딘타이펑,
# 중화항공, 자유시보), else 중국어 외래어 표기법 of the Mandarin reading, or the English reading the brand uses.
